prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
competitors_mentioned: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews
answer_verbatim:
For most small businesses, **Otterly.AI** is a strong starting choice. It is built to monitor “AI search visibility” across engines such as **ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews**, showing whether your business or website is mentioned for relevant prompts and which competitors appear instead.

Why it is a good small-business fit:

- Relatively simple to set up compared with enterprise AI-visibility platforms  
- Tracks brand mentions, citations, and competitor visibility  
- Lets you monitor a defined set of local/service-related prompts, such as “best plumber in Austin” or “family dentist near downtown Denver”  
- Useful for identifying which pages, directories, reviews, and sources AI engines appear to rely on  

Other worthwhile options:

- **Peec AI** — good for more detailed AI search/competitive reporting; better if you have an agency or marketing team.
- **Profound** — powerful enterprise-oriented AI visibility platform, generally more than a typical small business needs.
- **Scrunch AI** — useful for larger brands focused on optimizing content for AI answers.
- **Rankscale** — an option for testing how AI systems answer specific queries, though evaluate its supported engines and reporting depth before subscribing.

A practical recommendation: start with **Otterly.AI**, track 20–50 real customer questions, and compare your visibility against 3–5 local competitors for a month.

One caveat: no tool can perfectly tell you what every ChatGPT user sees. AI responses can change based on location, account settings, browsing/search mode, wording, and model updates. Treat these platforms as **repeatable prompt-monitoring tools**, not a literal record of every recommendation ChatGPT makes.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
